# check reports a pending journal without changing it.
exec tuck$exe init
mkdir .tuck-txn
cp unfinished.txt .tuck-txn/unfinished

exitcode 1 check --json
json
stdout '"ok": false'
stdout '"path": ".tuck-txn"'
stdout 'interrupted operation needs recovery'
stderr 'found 1 board issue'
exists .tuck-txn/unfinished
cmp .tuck-txn/unfinished unfinished.txt

-- unfinished.txt --
unfinished journal marker
